headline: LLM agents and retrieval pipelines anchor biomedical analysis in curated resources
label: Retrieval Grounded Biomedical Ai Agents
summary: Recent preprints and published work couple LLM reasoning to curated databases, literature, and biological tools for biomedical analysis.
synthesis: The dominant thread is grounding LLM behavior in structured or curated biomedical resources. BTE-RAG retrieves from a federated API of over sixty biomedical knowledge sources, and RAGulate assesses TF-target predictions against CollecTRI and PubMed evidence. A GPT-4 pipeline constrained by CEDAR metadata templates standardizes BioSample and GEO metadata, raising average dataset retrieval recall from 17.65% to 62.87%. A second group of items extends this coupling into agentic systems: Medea runs verified multi-step analyses with biological tools, ML models, and literature; PersonaAI mines 560,000 aging papers via RAG to propose hypotheses and validates them with autonomous single-cell RNA-seq; BiOmics combines explicit reasoning with latent embeddings for multi-omics interpretation; MARBLE iteratively refines bioinformatics models through debate-driven architecture changes. What is new across these items is the embedding of retrieval, verification, and tool execution within agent loops that generate or validate hypotheses.
